really disappointed - all of the reviews were so good so we were excited to finally find a good groomer near us. we dropped off our dog and the front desk woman was incredibly aloof - she would ask us questions about his cut preferences, etc and she’d barely listen to our answers. we went back in after about a minute after we left to confirm the cut preferences and it was clear that she wasn’t listening because she couldn’t recall anything from our conversation.

Also, they weren’t gentle with our dog by the way we saw the groomer grabbing him to put him into and out of the cage. They also said to come back after 3 hours and when we called, they still hadn’t started on him yet.

Lastly, they messed up his tail (see photo) and they also tried to charge us extra for services that we explicitly said to NOT include. And they didn’t give our dog any water the entire 5 hours he was there. When we picked him up, he was panting heavily and thirsty. We asked if he was given any water and they said “no, we can give him some now” and they still didn’t give any. Overall really disappointed and will not be returning.

Very disappointing experience with their mobile grooming service. I had trusted this business before, which is why this situation was so upsetting.

After picking up my dog Milo from his grooming appointment, we noticed he had a red eye. When I reviewed the picture sent by the groomer, I noticed his left eye already appeared different from the right. I also noticed his left ear appeared unevenly groomed, on the same side where his eye became irritated.

I understand accidents can happen, but what was most disappointing was the lack of honesty and communication. I emailed the business to address my concerns, but instead of taking responsibility or acknowledging that something may have happened, they assured me that nothing occurred to Milo while he was under their care.

My intention is not to create a problem — my only priority is Milo’s health and safety. Our pets cannot speak for themselves, so we have a responsibility to advocate for them. If we don’t stand up for our fur babies, who will?

If you use their mobile grooming service or any other service please make sure to carefully check your pets after their appointment. I would never want another pet to experience something similar or have an owner unaware that something may have happened.

Transparency, accountability, and honesty are extremely important when someone is caring for your pet.

**One Star — Money-Hungry Business and Horrific Customer Service**

The most important thing the owners of this company and the Astoria community need to know is that this place is a money-hungry business that overbooks to drive revenue, completely disregarding the clients' time and the pets' well-being. Before even going, I responsibly called at 10:00 a.m. to ask if they had availability, explicitly stating that if they were too busy, I could schedule for any other day.

They assured me they could take my dog. Yet, they kept me waiting a total of 6 hours. I was told he would be ready in two and a half hours, but they lied to me and made me wait an additional 3 hours PAST the promised time.
I was forced to wait outside under the scorching sun in my work clothes, having to cancel a crucial appointment with a client and losing money due to their chaotic management.

To make matters worse, they had the nerve to use the excuse that the groomer hadn't even been able to eat lunch all day—as if their scheduling disaster and greed were somehow my fault. If you know you are overbooked, do not accept the appointment.
The root of this issue lies in the complete incompetence and lack of professionalism at the front desk.

Jessica is entirely unfit for this position. She washes her hands of accountability by saying "she is just the receptionist and doesn't groom the dogs," proving she doesn't understand that she is supposed to be the communication bridge between the client and the groomer. Right after our phone call, I texted her reference photos and a written description of the exact haircut.

When I arrived, she had already lost them and couldn't find them, so I had to resend the text and photos a second time. I firmly repeated the instructions to her three times in person, emphasizing how specific I am with my dog's cut, and she smiled and agreed. When I returned at 3:30 p.m. and discovered they had lied about him being ready, I used that opportunity to remind her of the requirements yet again. It was a complete waste of time. The groomer themselves later came out and confirmed that Jessica never passed along any of my instructions and showed them a completely different photo instead, resulting in a rushed, terrible haircut.

Whenever Jessica is confronted with her errors, she hides behind stupid excuses. She questioned my preferences by asking "why I wanted to change my dog's breed" (a ridiculous argument, since long hair can be styled however the paying client requests) and told me I "should be grateful my dog was coming out healthy." The fact that they try to pitch my dog's basic physical safety as a favor rather than the bare minimum standard is the height of insolence. This was the fourth consecutive time they played the exact same game, ruining his hair and giving me the same garbage excuse to "let his hair grow and they will get it right next time."

I refused to pay because I am tired of having my money stolen by a business that just does whatever it wants and refuses to take clients' needs seriously. If you are in Astoria looking for a quality service where your time, money, and specifications are respected, avoid this place at all costs. If Jessica doesn't know how to do her job, she shouldn't be at the front desk. As per Jessica's request I am never coming back!
Always quick, professional, and caring with our little guy! Best groomer around, and you can’t beat the multiple locations! Our dog is skittish, but he always leaves looking sharp and feeling jolly.

UPDATE:

After my original review, the manager called me the next day to discuss what had happened. She apologized and offered a 50% refund for the grooming where my dog was injured. She also offered a complimentary future grooming with the owner, which I decided to accept.

I brought my miniature poodle, Theo, back yesterday, and I wanted to update my review because I believe it’s important to recognize when a business makes a genuine effort to address a mistake. Theo came out looking beautiful, and the experience was excellent. The grooming was exactly what we had originally hoped for, and I was very happy with the results.

My concerns about the initial incident and the lack of communication at the time still stand. However, I also want to acknowledge that management took the situation seriously, reached out proactively, and worked to make things right. Accidents can happen, but how a business responds afterward matters, and I appreciate the effort they made to regain my trust.

While I wish the original experience had never happened, I’m pleased to say that our follow-up visit was a very positive one, Theo looked fantastic, and we will definitely be coming back.

—

TL;DR: My dog was cut deeply enough to require glue, I wasn’t told until pickup, they blamed him for moving, cut his hair shorter than requested, and I paid full price.

I had a very concerning experience here and would not return.

During my dog’s grooming appointment, they made a deep cut into his paw. What’s most troubling is that no one called me immediately to inform me. Instead, I was receiving texts saying he was ready for pickup, and only when I arrived was I told about the injury. A cut deep enough to require sealing with “special glue” warrants an immediate phone call — not a casual mention at pickup.

When explaining what happened, staff blamed my dog for moving. Dogs move. That’s not an acceptable explanation for causing a significant cut. Groomers should be equipped to handle normal animal behavior safely.

They also cut his hair much shorter than we specifically requested. When I pointed it out, they admitted it but offered no explanation beyond “it just happened,” which is not reassuring.

To make matters worse, they framed the situation as though they were giving me a discount, but the “discount” was simply waiving a $40 brush-out fee that had been added when I dropped him off. I still ended up paying the standard grooming price — while leaving with a dog who had an open paw wound. I had to carry him home because I was worried about salt on the sidewalks potentially breaking down the glue and causing further injury.

Adding to my concern: while I was dropping my dog off, I overheard staff telling another customer that they had broken his cat’s nail because the cat moved. Hearing a nearly identical explanation given to another pet owner suggests this may not be an isolated incident.

Accidents can happen, but the lack of immediate communication, the pattern of blaming the animals, and the way the situation was handled are what make this especially troubling.

DO NOT GO HERE! I have taken my dog here for grooming many times. The last appointment was unacceptable. He had a 9:15am grooming appointment. I asked if I could drop him off at 8:30am because my sister was in the hospital. I dropped him off and somehow they thought he was in daycare all day. They didn't get to grooming until hours later so naturally he was antsy.  I called to find out if he had be finished as per usual and he wasn't even started. I could tell on the phone that they rushed his bath and sent him out. When he was received his ears were dirty, he coat not washed as per usual. He was not groomed in the manner he has been in the past. Yet I was CHARGED the full amount of $285!!!! Not even sure why so HIGH. I asked to redo him and they blamed my dog for being reactive. Mind you he had a 9:15 appointment as confirmed by their emails and texts and they didn't start him til later morning-midday. The fact that they sent him home without being clean and charged me is unacceptable. They told me they did not have a LARGE DOG GROOMER that day and can I bring him back the following. Tuesday or Wed when a more experienced groomer would be there..... WHAT? I asked to redo him but I couldn't do it Thanksgiving week so they said if I brought him back the following week to redo him THEY WOULD HAVE TO CHARGE ME AGAIN!!!! Because it would be too long. Are you kidding me?  I am SO DISAPPOINTED IN THIS Manager who chose this route for a loyal and generous customer.  I have always been VERY VERY GENEROUS TIPPING THE GROOMERS. I will not EVER COME BACK. Do not go here. Do not leave your credit card with them. Find another service.
